title: Keep a bounded implementation owner and controller acceptance

rubric.text: Chooses the implementation-capable resumable worker by capability and keeps the selected lead model unchanged.
Requires T1 scope, isolated base/worktree, files, relevant instructions, check, acceptance criteria, allowed actions, result and blocker, and a further-delegation boundary.
Retains the owner handle for repairs and requires controller inspection of commit and verification evidence before acceptance.
Performs read-only review without dispatch or mutation.
